intro: These terms set out the conditions for using the scheduling service "Kimaru" (the "Service") provided by Pinkoro General Incorporated Association (the "Company").
s1.p: These terms apply to all matters relating to the use of the Service between users and the Company.
s10.p: Pinkoro General Incorporated Association / Email: info@kimaru-co.jp
s2.p: Registration is done via Google social login or email and password. Users are responsible for keeping their registration information accurate and current and for properly managing their credentials.
s3.p: The Service offers a free plan and paid plans (Pro / ¥980 per month, tax included; Premium / ¥4,800 per month, tax included), billed via Square. Neither paid plan has a free trial; each is charged immediately upon registration and then automatically each month. The Premium plan includes additional features such as the external AI connection (MCP). If the contents or pricing of a plan change, the Company will announce this on the Service at the time of the change. Holders of an invite code (Cat Key) may use Pro features for free, subject to the Company's approval.
s4.p: Use of a Cat Key is subject to the Company's approval. If misuse, breach of these terms, withdrawal, or similar is found, the Company may forcibly downgrade the account's paid features to free. Improperly sharing or reselling invite codes is prohibited.
s5.p: The Service integrates with Google Calendar and similar services based on the user's permission. Integration can be disconnected at any time. Handling of the information obtained follows the Privacy Policy.
s6.p: Acts that violate laws or public order and morals, impersonation or unauthorized access, interference with the operation of the Service, and acts infringing the rights of other users or third parties are prohibited.
s6ai.p: Under the Premium plan, users may connect an external AI service they subscribe to (such as OpenAI's ChatGPT or Anthropic's Claude) to the Service and have that AI service read bookings, pre-meeting questionnaire answers, meeting notes, profiles, and similar data. The Company is not the provider of that AI service and does not warrant the accuracy or legality of its output. A user who enables the connection acknowledges that the data sent may include personal information of guests and other third parties, and does so at their own responsibility, including obtaining any consent required. The connection can be revoked at any time, and revoking invalidates every connection already issued. The Company may suspend this feature where misuse is suspected or where the Company otherwise deems it necessary for operating the Service.
s7.p: Except in cases of the Company's willful misconduct or gross negligence, the Company is not liable for service interruptions, data loss, or similar. The Company does not warrant against issues arising from specification changes or failures of external services such as Google, Zoom, or an external AI service the user has connected.
s8.p: The Company may change these terms as necessary. Material changes will be announced on the Service and take effect when posted on this page.
s9.p: These terms are governed by Japanese law, and the Osaka District Court shall be the court of exclusive agreed jurisdiction.
